source: 546 Monitor
target: 546 Monitor

source: Following the Governor of the Sea’s orders holds more weight than reverence for the Church…
target: Mandata gubernatoris maris exsequenda magis ponderosa sunt quam veneratio Ecclesiae…

source: The Earth Mother Church appears indifferent.
target: Ecclesia Matris Terrae indifferens videtur.

source: Lumian chose not to push further.
target: Lumian non voluit ulterius insistere.

source: He nodded subtly and stated, “I’ll take on this commission without expecting compensation, but I do have a request.”
target: Subtiliter annuit et dixit: “Hanc commissionem suscipiam sine praemio exspectando, sed habeo rogationem.”

source: “What might that be?” Rubió asked cautiously.
target: “Quid id esse possit?” caute rogavit Rubió.

source: A cunning smile formed on Lumian’s lips.
target: Risus callidus in labiis Lumiani apparuit.

source: “I’m here to witness the sea prayer ritual, but I’ve heard only a select few can observe its core segments. I seek such an opportunity.”
target: “Hic ad observandum ritum precationis maris adsum, sed audivi pauci electi solum segmenta eius centralia videre posse. Talis occasionem quaero.”

source: Rubió remained silent for a prolonged moment.
target: Rubió diu tacuit.

source: Giorgia, unable to contain her curiosity, questioned her husband in Highlander about the conversation and his concerns.
target: Giorgia, curiositatem reprimere non valens, marito suo in lingua Highlander de colloquio et eius sollicitudine interrogavit.

source: Lugano seized the chance to approach Lumian and translated the couple’s exchange.
target: Lugano opportunitatem ad Lumian accedendi arripuit et sermonem coniugum interpretatus est.

source: Lumian’s eyebrows twitched imperceptibly upon hearing they were genuinely considering allowing him to pose as a sailor and board the special sacrificial ship.
target: Supercilia Lumiani imperceptibiliter contorti sunt, audito eum, quod vere consultabant ut eum nauta fingere et in navem sacrificii specialem conscendere permitterent.

source: Is Rubió Paco truly considering my request?
target: Num Rubió Paco vere meam rogationem considerat?

source: I’m merely offering an outrageous deal to test if I can glean details about the sea prayer ritual.
target: Solum negotium insolitum offero ad testandum an possim ritu precationis maris notitias detegere.

source: I don’t intend to leverage this seemingly straightforward task to gain access to the last two segments of the ritual!
target: Non intendo hoc officium, quod simpliciter videtur, uti ad accessum ad duas ultimas partes ritu precationis maris obtinendum!

source: It remained a secret harbored by the Fisheries Guild for over a millennium, the wellspring of their power and prestige!
target: Secretum permanuit a Gilda Piscatorum per plus mille annos, fons potentiae et famae eorum!

source: As these thoughts raced through Lumian’s mind, he strongly suspected that the commission to send Madame Martha to Milo Village to meet the current Governor of the Sea carried a high risk.
target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem Lumiani celeriter transibant, firmiter suspicabatur commissionem, ad mittendam Dominae Marthae in vicum Milo ad conveniendum gubernatorem maris praesentem, magnum periculum ferre.

source: It wasn’t a task for any random Beyonder.
target: Hoc non erat opus cuiuslibet ignoti Beyonder.

source: Therefore, Rubió Paco was reluctant to let go of Louis Berry, the proven adventurer.
target: Itaque Rubió Paco non voluit dimittere Louis Berry, viatorem probatum.

source: But where could the danger lie?
target: Sed ubi periculum latere potest?

source: This is Port Santa, not the islands on the sea or the remote towns of the Southern Continent.
target: Hoc Portus Santa est, non insulae in mari nec oppida remota continenti meridionali.

source: Which Beyonder would dare to attack me on the streets in broad daylight?
target: Quis Beyonder auderet me in plateis pleno die oppugnare?

source: Aren’t they afraid of being captured by the combat nuns and turned into fertilizer for the land?
target: Nonne timent ne ab monachis pugnacibus capiantur et in stercus terrae vertantur?

source: One can’t underestimate the power of an orthodox Church!
target: Ne potentiam Ecclesiae orthodoxae subestimes!

source: Unless someone possesses a special ability, like Loki’s, to kill me undetected on the bustling streets, or if a Saint with godhood personally takes action, aiming to end the battle before the Church of Earth Mother reacts… But it can’t be that exaggerated.
target: Nisi quis facultatem specialem, ut Loki, habet ut me absque detectione in viis fervidis occidat, aut si Sanctus cum divinitate personaliter agere incipiat, propositum habens pugnam finire antequam Ecclesia Matris Terrae respondeat… Sed id non potest esse tam exaggeratum.

source: It’s such a trivial matter…
target: Res tam levissima est…

source: As Lumian pondered, Rubió and Giorgia reached a conclusion.
target: Dum Lumian meditabat, Rubió et Giorgia conclusionem attigerunt.

source: The former said to Lumian, “I cannot permit your participation in the last two segments of the sea prayer ritual.
target: Priore inquit ad Lumian: “Non possum tuam participationem in ultimis duobus segmentis ritu precationis maris sinere.

source: It is a blasphemy against the sea.
target: Est sacrilegium contra mare.

source: Those involved will face expulsion from Port Santa, including their family.
target: Qui in re haec versantur, expulsionem ex Portu Santa subibunt, etiam familia eorum!

source: “However, I am willing to allow you to conceal yourself in Milo Village in advance and witness the ancient performances during the vigil ritual.”
target: “Tamen paratus sum te sinere antea in Vicum Milo te celare et, durante ritu vigiliæ, antiquos spectaculos adspicere.”

source: So, I can’t directly witness the vigil ritual, but I can partake in the accompanying folklore performance?
target: Itaque non possum directe ritu vigiliæ adspectare, sed possum in spectaculo folklorico comitante participare?

source: Did Ultraman, Bard, and Mad Lady use a similar method to approach the core of the sea prayer ritual and complete the most crucial part of the prank?
target: Num Ultraman, Bardus, et Domina Insana similibus modis ad medium ritu precationis maris accesserunt et partem maxime cruciale ioci perfecerunt?

source: Lumian noticed that Rubió had already made a significant concession and no longer insisted.
target: Lumian animadvertit Rubió iam magnam concessionem fecerat, nec amplius instaret.

source: He smiled and replied, “Deal.”
target: Risus extulit et respondit: “Pactum.”

source: Without waiting for a response, he “kindly” suggested, “Let’s send Madame Martha to Milo Village today, shall we? We mustn’t delay when it comes to illnesses. Get her treatment as soon as possible.”
target: Non responsum expectans, benigne insinuavit: “Mitteamus Domina Marthae hodie in Vicum Milo, nonne? Morbis non differamus; celeriter illi medicinam adferamus.”

source: Rubió hesitated for a moment before saying, “My mother is already asleep.
target: Mater mea iam dormit.

source: She’s been resting a lot lately.
target: Nuper multum quiescit.

source: Forcing her awake will impact her body and mind.
target: Eam excitare corpus et mentem eius afficiet.

source: How about tomorrow morning?
target: Quid de mane cras?

source: Is some advanced preparation needed?
target: Nonne opus est aliqua praeparatione provecta?

source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully.
target: Lumian meditans annuit.

source: “No problem.”
target: «Nulla quaestio.»

source: He cast a quick glance at Lugano, and his heart skipped a beat.
target: Lugano celeriter aspexit, et cor eius palpitare coepit.

source: “Monsieur Rubió, my interpreter is, in fact, an excellent doctor.
target: «Domine Rubió, interpres meus revera medicus egregius est.

source: Moreover, he doesn’t adhere to the beliefs of the Earth Mother, nor is he affiliated with any Church.
target: Praeterea, nec fidem Matris Terrae sequitur, nec cum aliqua Ecclesia coniungitur.

source: If he were to treat your mother, you probably wouldn’t need to seek the Governor of the Sea’s permission in advance.
target: Si matrem tuam curaret, verisimiliter non opus esset ut gubernatoris maris permissionem praevie quaereres.

source: Lumian emphasized the word “doctor.”
target: Lumian verbum “medicus” extulit.

source: Without hesitation, Rubió Paco shook his head and said, “We trust the Church’s doctors more.
target: Sine mora, Rubió Paco caput movit et inquit: “Medicos Ecclesiae magis confidimus.

source: My mother is my most important family.
target: Mater mea mihi familia praecipua est.

source: I don’t want her to take any unnecessary risks.
target: Nolo ut pericula supervacua illi subeunda sint.

source: What he implied was that he couldn’t vouch for the medical skills of the interpreter.
target: Id quod ille insinuavit significabat, se non posse artes medicas interpres confirmare.

source: He couldn’t use the Paco family’s matriarch as an experiment.
target: Non potuit matriarcham familiae Paco uti in experimento.

source: Lumian was actually looking forward to sending Madame Martha to Milo Village because it meant he might meet the current Governor of the Sea and have a chance to learn something.
target: Lumian revera exspectabat Dominae Marthae mittendam ad Vicum Milo, quoniam id significabat se praesens gubernatorem maris contingere posse atque aliquid discere.

source: He had only suggested that Lugano treat the matriarch to test Rubió.
target: Solum suadebat ut Lugano matriarcham curaret, ut Rubió probaret.

source: The result of the probe revealed many hidden secrets in this matter!
target: Exitus indagationis multas arcana huius rei revelavit!

source: Having agreed to escort Madame Martha and her maid to the Governor of the Sea at 9 a.m. the following day, Lumian led Ludwig and Lugano out of the main house at 21 Saint Lana Street.
target: Cum convenissent ut Domina Martha et ancilla eius gubernatori maris ad horam nonam mane diei sequentis comitabantur, Lumian Ludwig et Lugano ex domo principali in via Saint Lana 21 duxit.

source: Giorgia walked them all the way to the door.
target: Giorgia eos ad ianuam duxit.

source: Lumian nonchalantly remarked, “Does the Governor of the Sea have to reside in Milo Village?”
target: Lumian leviter inquit: “Num gubernator maris in Vicum Milo habitare debet?”

source: With Lugano’s translation, Giorgia nodded slightly and said, “The Governor of the Sea resides in the building where the vigil ritual is held every night. He can move freely during the day, but he can’t leave Port Santa.”
target: Per Lugani interpretationem, Giorgia leviter annuit et inquit: “Gubernator maris in aedificio residet ubi ritu vigiliae omni nocte celebratur. Diurno tempore libere movere potest, sed Portum Santa relinquere non potest.”

source: The building where the vigil ritual is held? The essence of the vigil ritual is to allow a quasi‑Governor of the Sea to enter the residence and replace the former Governor of the Sea, waiting to be officially appointed by the sea the next day?
target: Aedificium ubi ritu vigiliae celebratur? Anima huius rituo est ut quasi gubernator maris intra domum ingrediatur et pristinus gubernator subrogetur, exspectans ut mare proximo die officialiter eum constituat?

source: Lumian speculated, combining his mysticism knowledge.
target: Lumian speculatus est, scientia mystica sua coniuncta.

source: He smiled and asked, “What are the perks of being Governor of the Sea?”
target: Risus extulit et quaesivit: “Qua sunt beneficia esse gubernator maris?”

source: After hearing the translation, Giorgia fell silent for a few seconds before saying, “Among the fishmongers, the merchants, he’s already the true governor in their eyes.”
target: Audita interpretatione, Giorgia paucis momentis siluit, deinde inquit: “Inter piscatores et mercatores, iam verus gubernator est.”

source: It wasn’t an answer, just a whisper of truth.
target: Non erat responsum, sed tantum susurrus veritatis.

source: Lumian nodded without pressing further.
target: Lumian annuit sine ulteriore impetu.

source: He led Ludwig and Lugano through the iron gates.
target: Ludwig et Lugano per portas ferreas duxit.

source: After taking a few steps along the verdant path in the forest, he suddenly looked up.
target: Postquam paucos passus in via viridi per silvam fecit, subito surrexit et ad caelum respexit.

source: On a branch stood a gray‑feathered myna.
target: In ramo stabat myna plumata cinerea.

source: Lumian gave it a cursory glance and continued on, his steps brisk towards the waiting carriage.
target: Lumian illud celeriter intuebatur et perrexit, passibus agilibus versus currum exspectantem.

source: After a while, the myna flapped its wings and flew up.
target: Post aliquod tempus, myna alas pulsavit et surrexit volavit.

source: After circling a few times, it circled a house two streets away before dipping down towards an open window.
target: Post aliquot circuitus, domum duabus plateis remotam circumvolvit, deinde ad fenestram apertam decedens.

source: It landed on a middle‑aged man’s forearm and spoke in precise Highlander, “Louis Berry is back at the Paco house! He stayed nearly half an hour!”
target: In antebrachium viri mediocris consedit et in lingua Highlander precisa dixit: “Louis Berry ad domum Paco rediit! Fere dimidiam horam mansit!”

source: The middle‑aged man, dressed in gray clothes with disheveled brown hair, resembling a suburban farmer, fed the myna a few self‑made rice grains and said, “Observe further and see if Rubió Paco and Giorgia will go out today.”
target: Vir mediocris aetatis, vestitu griseo indutus, capillis fuscis inordinatis, quasi agricolae suburbani similis, mynae aliquot grana oryzae sua confecta dedit et dixit: “Observa amplius et vide si Rubió Paco et Giorgia hodie exibunt.”

source: After the myna flew out of the window, the middle‑aged man exhaled and turned around.
target: Postquam myna e fenestra volavit, vir mediocris suspiravit et conversus est.

source: Suddenly, his eyes froze as he saw someone sitting in the only armchair!
target: Subito, oculi eius immobiliter steterunt, cum aliquem in unica sella bracchiali sedere vidit!

source: The man had black hair and green eyes, wearing a white shirt, a black vest, dark pants, and a golden straw hat.
target: Vir capillos nigros et oculos virides habebat, indutus camisia alba, lorica nigra, bracas obscuras, et pileum stramineum aureum gestans.

source: Louis Berry!
target: Louis Berry!

source: Adventurer Louis Berry!
target: Louis Berry, audax viator!

source: The middle‑aged man’s back arched slightly, and his feet parted slightly, but he took no further action.
target: Dorsum viri mediocris leviter arcitum est, pedes paulum separaverunt, sed nihil amplius egerit.

source: Lumian leaned back in his chair and engaged in casual conversation in Intisian, as if he had been expected.
target: Lumian in sella sua reclinavit et sermonem casualem in Intisian gessit, quasi exspectatus esset.

source: “What did you have your bird spy on?”
target: «Quid voluisti ut avis tua specularetur?»

source: The middle‑aged man fell silent for a moment before speaking in somewhat awkward Intisian, “Watch if anyone enters or exits Paco’s house, and see if there’s anything unusual there.”
target: Vir mediocris parum tacuit antequam in Intisian paulo ineptam loquens dixit: “Observa si quis domum Paco intrat aut exit, et vide si quid insolitum ibi accidat.”

source: “Very honest.” Lumian nodded approvingly. “Who asked you to do it?”
target: «Valde honestum,» Lumian annuit approbans. «Quis te ad hoc faciendum rogavit?»

source: He was pleased that the other party knew some Intisian.
target: Laetatus est quod altera pars nonnullas notiones Intisianae haberet.

source: Otherwise, he could only rely on key words to communicate or capture him to have Lugano translate.
target: Alioquin solum verbis clavis inniti posset, aut eum capere ut Lugano interpretaret.

source: “Juan Oro,” the middle‑aged man replied without hesitation.
target: «Juan Oro,» respondit vir mediocris sine mora.

source: Juan Oro… The president of the Fisheries Guild and the former village chief of Milo Village?
target: Juan Oro… Praeses Gildae Piscatorum et quondam dux vici Milo?

source: Lumian smiled and said, “I’m surprised you’re so forthright.”
target: Lumian subridens inquit: “Miror te tam aperte loqui!”

source: The middle‑aged man forced a smile and said, “I don’t think I’m stronger than Demon Warlock and can defeat you.”
target: Vir mediocris risum simulavit et dixit: “Non puto me fortiorem esse quam Daemon Warlock et te superare posse.”

source: “That’s right. Those who understand the situation and themselves can live longer.”
target: «Ita est. Qui rem et se intellegunt, diutius vivere possunt.»

source: Lumian crossed his right foot over his left leg.
target: Lumian pedem dextrum super crurum sinistrum imposuit.

source: “Why is Juan Oro monitoring the Paco family?”
target: «Cur Juan Oro familiam Paco inspicit?»

source: “I don’t know, and there’s no need for me to know.
target: «Nescio, neque mihi opus est id scire.»

source: “I’ll receive a reward as long as I pass on what I see,” the middle‑aged man replied sincerely.
target: «Praemium accipiam, dummodo id quod video tradam,» respondit vir mediocris sincere.

source: Lumian gazed at him for a few seconds before saying, “Did you send that little monster last night?”
target: Lumian eum paucis momentis intuens dixit: “Misitne illud parvum monstrum hesterno nocte?”

source: The middle‑aged man was taken aback.
target: Vir mediocris obstupefactus est.

source: “What little monster? What happened last night?”
target: «Quid parvum monstrum? Quid hesterno nocte accidit?»

source: Lumian chuckled and stood up without explaining.
target: Lumian subridens stetit et surrexit sine explicatione.

source: “What’s your name?” he asked as he walked towards the door.
target: «Quid est tibi nomen?» inquit, ambulans ad ianuam.

source: The middle‑aged man hesitated for a moment before answering truthfully, “Sanches.”
target: Vir mediocris paulum dubitavit antequam veraciter respondit: “Sanches.”

source: Lumian opened the door, walked out, and disappeared from Sanches’s sight.
target: Lumian ianuam aperuit, exiit, et ab Sanches conspectu evanuit.

source: Upon his return to Solow Motel, Lumian noticed a folded letter resting on the master bedroom’s desk.
target: Rediens ad Solow Motel, Lumian litteram plicatam in mensa cubiculi principalis reposam animadvertit.

source: Skillfully unfurling it, he found the distinct handwriting of Madam Magician.
target: Abiliter eam evolvens, invenit caligraphiam distinctam Dominae Magician.

source: “You can share those matters with the Two of Cups, but avoid delving into excessive detail.
target: «Has res potes cum Duobus Poculis communicare, sed cave ne nimiam subtilitatem ingeras.»

source: “I refrained from elaborating on the voices you heard and the fragments of civilization you glimpsed earlier as they remain too advanced for your understanding.
target: «Abstuli a prolixa exponendo de vocibus quas audivisti et de fragmentis civilitatis, quae antea conspexisti, quoniam nimis provectae sunt ad tuam intellegentiam.»

source: Simply remember not to heed random sounds or sights in an ancient ruin like Fourth Epoch Trier.
target: «Memento ne fortuitos sonos aut imagines in ruina antiqua, sicut Trier Aetatis Quartae, attendas.»

source: Also, caution your Warlock associates—
target: Etiam, cave socios tuos Warlock—

source: it’s acceptable to occasionally take in the Hidden Sage’s indoctrination, but they mustn’t fully believe in Him.
target: acceptabile est interdum indoctrinationem Sapiens Occulti capere, sed in eum plene credere non debeant.

source: His state is precarious.
target: Status eius precarius est.

source: After incinerating the letter, Lumian contemplated for a moment and decided to “teleport” back to Trier to inform Franca in person and avert any potential mishaps.
target: Litteram incineratam, Lumian paulisper meditatus est et decrevit se ad Trier “teleportare”, ut Francam personaliter certiorem faceret et eventus malos praecaveret.

source: Trier, nestled within the Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702 at 9 Rue Orosai.
target: Trier, in Quartiere Cathédralis Commemorativæ, Apartamentum 702 in 9 Rue Orosai.

source: As Lumian materialized, Franca and Jenna were engrossed in perusing a stack of ancient information from an unknown source.
target: Cum Lumian apparuit, Franca et Jenna in perlegi fasciculum antiquarum notitiarum ex fonte ignoto occupatae erant.

source: “Hey, could you ‘teleport’ outside and knock? It’s quite startling when you suddenly appear like that!” Franca nearly tensed the formless spider silk she’d permanently set up in the room.
target: «Heus, potesne extra “teleportare” et pulsare? Mirum est, cum subito appareas taliter!» Franca paene contraxit sericum araneum informem, quod in conclavi constanter posuerat.

source: Lumian chuckled and remarked, “With a Witch’s spiritual perception, what’s the difference between me ‘teleporting’ outside the door and appearing in the living room?”
target: Lumian subridens inquit: “Cum perceptione spirituali Magae, quaenam est differentia inter me extra ianuam “teleportare” et in camera vivendi apparere?”

source: “Why the sudden return?” Franca paused before asking, “Madame Magician said you could share about that matter?”
target: «Cur tam subito redieris?» Franca paulisper cessavit antequam quaresceret: «Domina Magician dixit te de hac re communicare posse?»

source: “What’s going on?” Jenna queried, looking puzzled.
target: «Quid agitur?» Jenna quaesivit, aspectu perplexo.

source: She stood up and prepared to leave.
target: Surgens stetit et se ad discedendum praeparavit.

source: “Yes,” Lumian replied to Franca’s question, but he made no attempt to stop Jenna from leaving.
target: «Ita,» Lumian respondit Francae, sed nihil conatus est Jenna discedere prohibere.

source: Nor did Franca intervene.
target: Neque Franca intercedit.

source: Once Jenna had retreated to her bedroom, Lumian turned to Franca and disclosed, “When they discussed the wilderness dream, it made me recall the voices and visions I encountered in Fourth Epoch Trier. They’re connected to the Celestial Master!”
target: Postquam Jenna ad cubiculum suum recessit, Lumian ad Francam se vertit et enuntiavit: “Cum de somnio silvestri disseruissent, mihi recordatae sunt voces et visionibus quas in Trier Aetatis Quartae occurrerant. Illae cum Magistro Caelesti coniunctae sunt!”
